title: Private Ybor History and Cuban Heritage Tour in Tampa
includes: Tours Offered in English and Spanish
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a private, exclusive tour in Tampa with your own local guide. Discover the rich history and Cuban heritage of Ybor City on this walking tour of its historic district. 

In the heart of Ybor, walk through one of Florida's most distinctive historic districts. Explore the people, architecture and traditions that made this neighborhood the "Cigar Capital of the World." Stroll along the historic 7th Avenue where cigar factories, social clubs and immigrant businesses once flourished. Visit the iconic Cuban Club and learn how it became the cultural heart of Tampa's Cuban community. Along the way, hear stories of visionary founders, skilled cigar makers and diverse communities. See how its past shaped Ybor City into a thriving community whose legacy continues today.

Please note: The availability and accessibility of attractions may vary based on time of day and crowd conditions, ensuring each visit is a unique experience.
